description: Astera Oracle & Numerology combines a 36-card Victorian Oracle with deterministic Pythagorean numerology. Use it for daily cards, Yes/No readings, relationship and situation spreads, Life Path and Name Number calculations, compatibility, personal cycles, and deeper numerology profiles. Oracle readings can include the original card artwork. Interpretations are intended for personal reflection and entertainment, not professional advice.

defaultPrompt: Draw my Victorian Oracle card of the day.
What does this person feel about me, what are they thinking, and how are they likely to act?
Create my full numerology profile from my name and birth date.
